next_actions: 1. Create docs/design/proposal/architecture/uncertainty-contract-v1.md. Begin with the research question and evidence contract: can a history family support conditioning, evidence updates and conditional outcomes without inventing weights, double-counting evidence or discarding unresolved regions? Record each material default with provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and provisional status.

2. Define the integrated request/result records. Require immutable request, family/view, evidence-block, model, time-cutoff and dependency identities; preserve parent views; separate structural validity, mathematical status, empirical justification, capability status and computation status; and specify atomic rejection with unchanged prior state.

3. Specify conditioning. Distinguish exogenous stress, observational conditioning and structural intervention. For finite events require admissible information, compatible cutoffs and positive denominator; return an explicit undefined/unsupported disposition for zero mass, unavailable law or inadmissible information. Require an explicit conditional model for continuous point conditioning.

4. Specify likelihood updates and duplicate-information protection. Give each observation block an identity, purpose, dependency set and overlap status. A repeated source, alternate extraction, correction, or total/component restatement cannot silently supply an independent factor. Unknown dependence blocks independent updating. Corrections derive from the appropriate retained base and preserve superseded records.

5. Specify conditional outcomes. Key rows by history, condition, scenario, path and date; retain typed joint quantities, accounting/journal references, dependencies, assumptions and status (`exact`, `symbolic`, `sampled`, `certified_bound`, `explored_range`, `unresolved`). Preserve unresolved mass and distinguish economic default from unsupported or numerical failure. Conditional-on-success queries must display their denominator; unweighted families must not receive invented means or quantiles.

6. Add representative success/failure fixtures in uncertainty-fixtures-v1.json. Include the two exact finite examples above, a duplicate/overlap rejection, zero-normalizer rejection, a weighted partial result retaining unresolved mass, an explicitly requested conditional-on-completion result, and an unweighted feasible-set result. Every failure fixture must include reason code, dependencies, preserved records and absence of a partial write.

7. Compare linked family representations with self-contained joint representations while holding histories, law, evidence blocks, cutoffs and requested outcomes fixed. Compare weighted and unweighted reporting as different questions, without ranking by arithmetic or prototype behavior. State continuous/mixed-measure and causal-intervention evaluation as deferred obligations.

8. Save each substantive section and fixture group before starting the next. Update architecture.json only if the uncertainty row now has complete inputs, outputs, invariants, failure behavior, alternatives, rationale and fixture references; otherwise retain it in unfinished_contracts and register the completed portions as bounded work. Update result.md and progress.md with actual changed files, checks, decision-table status and the first unfinished section.

9. Stop when the uncertainty contract, fixtures and bounded checks are saved and internally consistent, or earlier at the worker save margin. The next task after independent substantive review is accounting/state-transition contracts; do not begin that work in this attempt.
